claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Repaglinide is a sulfonylurea insulin secretagogue with no known cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Repaglinide is a sulfonylurea insulin secretagogue with no known cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
